config.design: H533 eight-family suite reused, two split-specific formats and lexicons, paired answer-changing endpoints plus same-answer nuisance. Prefix Yesterday, to all entity-binding prompts to align name tokenization, motivated by H820. Not fresh task confirmation. No task-driven candidate replacement.
config.candidates: All16 H839 phi-selected scalar48/block8 components at sites1/2, both seeds. Candidate selection uses prior natural-text stability only.
config.gate: Per family/split >=4 token-valid pairs, both-endpoint binary correctness >=.75, pooled full-vocab intended-group top1 >=.5. No individual competence filtering.
config.analysis: Final-position normalized preMLP state; training-token-mean subtraction and frozen training scale. Report support, decoded contribution agreement, paired task-changing vs nuisance contribution distance. Descriptive availability only, no causal/semantic evidence.
config.next_lock: Keep all candidates. Causal swaps should use every valid pair in competent family/split cells, both seeds, task-changing and nuisance donor, plus matched-direction and identity controls. Do not rank candidates by this task screen.
